articles.summary: Reverse Stock-Split to Be Effective on November 25, 2026 Winnipeg, Manitoba–(Newsfile Corp. – November 23, 2026) – Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. (NASDAQ: FNUC) (the “Company” or “Frontier“), a nuclear fuel cycle, today announced that it will effect a 1-for-15 reverse stock split (“Reverse Stock Split”) of its common shares, no par value per share […]
